description: A two-panel composite of linear-fitting "relationship maps" used for the constitutive/activation-energy analysis of a hot-deformed Fe-Mn-Al-C steel (Gleeble-3500, T = 900-1150 °C, ε̇ = 0.01-10 s⁻¹). Panel (a) plots ln(ε̇/s⁻¹) on the y-axis (range −5.25 to 3.50, ticks every 1.75) against ln[sinh(ασp)] on the x-axis (−1.50 to 2.25, ticks every 0.75); six symbol/colour-coded data sets are labelled by deformation temperature — 900 °C (black squares), 950 °C (red circles), 1000 °C (blue up-triangles), 1050 °C (magenta down-triangles), 1100 °C (green diamonds), 1150 °C (navy left-triangles) — with the printed annotation k1 = 5.135. Panel (b) plots ln[sinh(ασp)] on the y-axis (−1 to 3) against 1000T⁻¹/K⁻¹ on the x-axis (0.70 to 0.85, ticks every 0.05), with four data sets coded by strain rate — 0.01 s⁻¹ (black squares), 0.1 s⁻¹ (red circles), 1 s⁻¹ (blue up-triangles), 10 s⁻¹ (magenta down-triangles) — and printed annotation k2 = 15.690. Every fitted line has positive slope. In (a) the 1050-1150 °C lines are steeper and more closely grouped than the 900-1000 °C lines, so the family is clearly not parallel; in (b) ln[sinh(ασp)] increases with strain rate at a fixed 1000T⁻¹ and the four lines are well separated. Together the panels supply the two average slopes required for the Zener-Hollomon activation-energy calculation.
measured_quantities: dynamic recrystallization activation energy (kJ mol⁻¹, stated only in the citing text as 669.844)

observations.observation: Panel (a) has y-axis labelled ln(ε̇/s⁻¹) with ticks −5.25, −3.50, −1.75, 0.00, 1.75, 3.50 and x-axis labelled ln[sinh(ασp)] with ticks −1.50, −0.75, 0.00, 0.75, 1.50, 2.25.

Panel (a) legend lists six deformation temperatures — 900 °C (black squares), 950 °C (red circles), 1000 °C (blue up-triangles), 1050 °C (magenta down-triangles), 1100 °C (green diamonds) and 1150 °C (navy left-triangles).
The value k1 = 5.135 is printed as an annotation inside panel (a).
Panel (b) has x-axis labelled 1000T⁻¹/K⁻¹ with ticks 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85 and y-axis labelled ln[sinh(ασp)] with ticks −1, 0, 1, 2, 3.
Panel (b) legend lists four strain rates — 0.01 s⁻¹ (black squares), 0.1 s⁻¹ (red circles), 1 s⁻¹ (blue up-triangles) and 10 s⁻¹ (magenta down-triangles).
The value k2 = 15.690 is printed as an annotation inside panel (b).
In panel (a) the fitted straight lines are not parallel: the lines for the 1050, 1100 and 1150 °C data sets are steeper and bundled closer together than the lines for 900, 950 and 1000 °C.
In panel (b) at a fixed 1000T⁻¹ the fitted lines are ordered by strain rate, with 10 s⁻¹ highest and 0.01 s⁻¹ lowest, and all four lines have similar positive slope.
The citing text states that the average slopes of the curves in Fig. 4(a) and (b) from linear fitting are k1 = 5.135 and k2 = 15.690.

The citing text states the dynamic recrystallization activation energy of the Fe-Mn-Al-C steel is 669.844 kJ mol⁻¹, obtained from these slopes via formula (2); this number is not printed anywhere in the figure.

The citing text states the parallelism of the fitted lines in Fig. 4 is not good, indicating that deformation conditions significantly affect the activation energy, so the calculated activation energy is only an average over the experimental range.

The citing text states hot deformation was studied at T = 900-1150 °C and ε̇ = 0.01-10 s⁻¹ using a Gleeble-3500 thermo-mechanical simulator; the figure axes 1000T⁻¹ = 0.70-0.85 K⁻¹ are consistent with that temperature interval.

The caption is OCR-degraded ('Fig. 4 e Relationship maps of ln_ ln sinh as (a) and ln sinh as 1000=T (b)') but describes (a) as a ln ε̇-ln sinh relationship map and (b) as an ln sinh-1000/T map, matching the axis labels.
No numeric data labels are printed on the individual data points; only the tick values and the two slope annotations k1 and k2 are numeric text in the figure.

subfigures.description: Linear-fit plot of ln(ε̇/s⁻¹) vs ln[sinh(ασp)]; six temperature-coded data sets (900, 950, 1000, 1050, 1100, 1150 °C) each fitted with a positive-slope straight line. Annotation k1 = 5.135 is printed inside the axes. The fitted lines are not parallel, the high-temperature group being steeper.

Linear-fit plot of ln[sinh(ασp)] vs 1000T⁻¹/K⁻¹ over 0.70-0.85 K⁻¹; four strain-rate-coded data sets (0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 s⁻¹) fitted with straight lines of similar positive slope. Annotation k2 = 15.690 is printed inside the axes; the 10 s⁻¹ line lies highest and 0.01 s⁻¹ lowest.
